newsitem.title: EGYPT: U.S. carrier Enterprise at mouth of Suez canal.
newsitem.headline: U.S. carrier Enterprise at mouth of Suez canal.

text.p: The U.S. aircraft carrier Enterprise arrived off Port Said at the northern end of the Suez Canal on Saturday en route to join U.S. forces in the Gulf, port sources said.
The carrier, with about 75 warplanes aboard, is expected to enter the canal in the early hours of Sunday and come out into the Gulf of Suez in the afternoon, they said.
It has steamed from the Adriatic Sea to join the U.S. aircraft carrier Carl Vinson and the other forces assembled in the Gulf for possible action against Iraqi targets.

The Enterprise planes include F-14 fighters recently modified to carry accurate laser-guided bombs. They strengthen a force that includes four B-52 bombers now based on the Indian Ocean island of Diego Garcia and eight U.S. Stealth fighters that arrived in Kuwait from the United States on Friday.
